title: Introduce unified retry heuristics and lightweight stream adapters for cross-SDK parity
author: Maya Thompson
description: Problem: SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) diverged in retry defaults and streaming ergonomics after several incremental fixes. This caused mismatched failure modes in production: some clients aggressively retried transient 5xxs and caused thundering retries; others exposed low-level streaming primitives that made simple restart/reauth flows awkward. Goal: unify retry heuristics (backoff shape, max attempts, idempotency heuristics) and introduce a compact, cross-language lightweight StreamAdapter facade that simplifies resumable stream consumer code and standardizes token-refresh hooks. This PR implements the following across SDKs and docs: - A shared retry profile DSL (exposed as config objects in each SDK) with default presets: conservative, standard, aggressive - Uniform default: "standard" with jittered exponential backoff (base=100ms, factor=2, cap=10s, max_attempts=4), plus opt-in aggressive preset for batch workloads - Idempotency-based retry gating: automatically reduces retries for non-idempotent operations unless caller explicitly marks them safe - StreamAdapter: a tiny facade that wraps underlying WS/HTTP chunked streams to provide resume, heartbeat, and credential-refresh hooks with a minimal callback surface - Session priming helper to pre-warm credential leases for long-lived streams - Cross-SDK tests and integration harness updates (local smoke + downstream example app) - Version bumps: python sdk -> 1.7.0, typescript sdk -> 2.4.0, go sdk -> v0.13.0 Rationale: having consistent retry behavior reduces production surprises and makes server-side load profiles predictable. A compact, well-specified stream adapter lowers the cognitive load on app authors integrating streaming LLM responses while enabling consistent token refresh semantics for private/dedicated deployments. Checklist: - [x] Implement retry DSL in each SDK - [x] Implement StreamAdapter facade in each SDK - [x] Add unit and integration tests (cross-sdk harness) - [x] Update changelogs and version numbers - [x] Update docs and quickstart examples - [x] Run perf smoke tests and adjust defaults as needed Related: Linear ENG-2043 ENG-2198; internal incident notes INT-582 (stream reconnect storm). See design doc: https://linear.redwood.ai/notes/ENG-2043-unified-retry-and-stream-adapter for full rationale and migration notes.

release_notes: Unify retry defaults across SDKs and introduce a compact StreamAdapter facade to simplify resumable streaming and credential-refresh flows. Default retry profile is now 'standard' (jittered exponential, max_attempts=4). Includes SDK version bumps: python 1.7.0, typescript 2.4.0, go v0.13.0. See docs/guides/retries.md and docs/guides/streaming.md for migration notes.
